newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Protests suspend cargo delivery at Bangladesh port.
newsitem.headline: Protests suspend cargo delivery at Bangladesh port.

text.p: Cargo deliveries at Bangladesh's main Chittagong port remained suspended on Thursday, a day after workers walked out in protest over the recruitment of new employees, port officials said.
The officials said the stoppage did not affect loading and unloading, but could do so if goods and containers continued to pile up.
They said existing workers were angered over fresh recruits for jetties and on ships in the outer anchorage and stopped work at 1800 GMT on Wednesday.
"The stoppage has deprived the customs and port authorities of huge revenue," said one official.
He said the action also stranded hundreds of lorries and railway wagons waiting to transport cargoes.
"If the strike continues, the port will face congestion at cargo sheds and container yards," he added.
There were 20 ships unloading cargo at the jetties on Thursday while nine were awaiting berths.
